## Contribution checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] This change includes tests or explains why tests are not applicable.
- [ ] I did not commit credentials, tokens, private URLs, or generated artifacts.
- [ ] I verified that outbound network access remains allowlisted.
- [ ] I documented any security, privacy, or migration impact.

## Security impact

Describe any change involving authentication, authorization, file uploads, outbound URLs, secrets, dependencies, Docker, or CI/CD. Write `None` when not applicable.
